description: Shared-rule candidates found while authoring actions.logic.json — inlined there for now (same shape as a logic_rules entry). class_ep_stance (see classes.shared.json) is also used by action_empty_posture / action_empty_move.

candidates.name: The action card is in hand
candidates.description: A, B, M, P need their card in the hand; EP and EM never do. The logic blocks read {"var": "caster.hand_has.<code>"}; as a named rule the hand is passed as a code list so the code can be a parameter.

candidates.name: Empty Move — halfway toward the target
candidates.description: EM walks ceil(dist / 2) hexes along the shortest path (= round(d/2) for integer d), at least 1 when the target is not the actor's own tile. Used by action_empty_move, class_rogue and battle_system_core.

candidates.name: Validation — rps lists name exactly the cycle neighbours
candidates.description: A battle action's rps_wins_against is exactly [win_code] and rps_loses_against exactly [lose_code] (A>P, P>M, M>B, B>A). Repeated in the four A/B/M/P validations.

candidates.name: Validation — no rps edges
candidates.description: Empty and meta actions (EP, EM, COMBO, TRADE, ENTER, DOOR) keep both rps lists empty. Repeated in six validations.

candidates.name: Damage an attacker takes from a Block
candidates.description: B>A scores 1 on an attacker in contact unless the attacker holds Ranged Weapon (then 0). Used from both sides: action_attack.damage_taken_from_block and action_block.combat_damage_per_attacker.
